operation_plan: Create/configure exact dipole in a new instance; verify target and units
Save the prepared fixture at its controller-created target
Launch one asynchronous simulation and establish running
Submit stop intent while one five-second wait is pending on the same serialized connection
Send at most one stop, only if still applicable after the wait
Up to three bounded start-state and three bounded termination-state observations, plus owned-project messages
Close the owned instance only after known idle, then bounded transport cleanup
consequences: Transport cleanup may terminate this disposable instance and lose partial results. Uncertainty blocks all further tools; human intervention in CST may be necessary.
restrictions: No existing-instance attachment, preexisting-file overwrite, automatic retry, alternate target, model endpoint, watcher, private SDK preservation hooks or production changes.
normal_project_save: Initial non-overwriting creation followed by one ordinary save of that same newly created project to persist its configured fixture; never replace an external file.
no_publication: No commits, pushes, GitHub comments, closure or map updates.
partial_contract_revision: The human confirmed removing mid-task task cancellation. Ordinary prompts wait for task completion or a pause requiring input; simulation stop remains the control exception being investigated. No emergency-stop guarantee.
